business.description: The Company is engaged in the business of Trading of Coal. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of investment and trading in shares and securities.

products.name: Traded Goods (Coal)
products.note: Revenue from sale of traded goods Rs 22.50 lakhs in 2025-26; stock of coal written off as not saleable

outlook.statement: The Company's future performance will depend substantially upon market conditions and its ability to identify appropriate investment opportunities while managing the associated risks. The management remains cautiously optimistic about the long-term prospects of the Indian securities market.

risks: changes in interest rates, inflation and overall economic conditions, domestic and international political and geopolitical developments, changes in taxation and other governmental policies
